orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To build a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities, we will allocate funds across bonds with maturities ranging from 1 to 5 years. This approach ensures a steady stream of income and gradual reinvestment opportunities, which helps mitigate interest rate risk. Each maturity bucket will hold no more than 20% of the portfolio to comply with the laddered maturity structure requirement. The proposed allocation will keep the portfolio duration below 7 years, well within the 10-year maximum limit. The selected bonds are all investment-grade, ensuring they meet the minimum credit rating requirement. The laddered structure will also provide liquidity and the ability to reinvest at potentially higher rates as each bond matures.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Allocate 20% to US Treasury Note (1-year maturity), 20% to Microsoft 1.875% Notes due 2025 (2-year maturity), 20% to Apple 2.150% Notes due 2026 (3-year maturity), 20% to IBM 2.875% Notes due 2027 (4-year maturity), and 20% to Johnson & Johnson 2.950% Notes due 2028 (5-year maturity). This laddered bond portfolio ensures a steady stream of income and gradual reinvestment opportunities, while keeping the portfolio duration below 7 years and maintaining investment-grade securities.
